WITH config AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS values
  FROM settings
  WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY[
    'MONETIZATION_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN','MONETIZATION_CALCULATION_VERSION',
    'MONETIZATION_ORIGINALITY_WEIGHT','MONETIZATION_POLICY_WEIGHT',
    'MONETIZATION_ADVERTISER_WEIGHT','MONETIZATION_PRODUCTION_WEIGHT',
    'MONETIZATION_ENGAGEMENT_WEIGHT','MONETIZATION_COPYRIGHT_RISK_WEIGHT',
    'MONETIZATION_REUSED_RISK_WEIGHT','MONETIZATION_PRODUCTION_DURATION_WEIGHT',
    'MONETIZATION_HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD','MONETIZATION_POLICY_SOURCE_SCORES',
    'MONETIZATION_ADVERTISER_FORMAT_SCORES','MONETIZATION_PRODUCTION_FORMAT_SCORES'
  ])
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow,status,metadata)
  SELECT '06 - TrendLens - Monetization Engine','running',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'max_videos_per_run',coalesce((values ->> 'MONETIZATION_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN')::integer,1000),
           'calculation_version',coalesce(values ->> 'MONETIZATION_CALCULATION_VERSION','v1'),
           'configuration',coalesce(values,'{}'::jsonb)
         )
  FROM config
  RETURNING id,started_at,metadata
)
SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id,started_at AS run_started_at,
       (metadata ->> 'max_videos_per_run')::integer AS max_videos_per_run,
       metadata ->> 'calculation_version' AS calculation_version
FROM started;

WITH result AS (
  SELECT * FROM refresh_video_monetization_scores($2::integer,$3::timestamptz)
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET items_received=result.candidates_selected::integer,
      items_processed=result.scores_upserted::integer,
      items_skipped=greatest(result.candidates_selected-result.scores_upserted,0)::integer,
      metadata=metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'eligible_classifications',result.eligible_classifications,
        'engagement_quality_available',result.engagement_quality_available,
        'high_risk_scores',result.high_risk_scores,
        'calculation_version',result.calculation_version,
        'calculated_at',result.calculated_at
      )
  FROM result
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.items_received,updated.items_processed,
       updated.items_skipped,updated.items_failed,result.*
FROM updated CROSS JOIN result;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=coalesce(finished_at,current_timestamp),
      status='success',
      duration_seconds=coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at)))
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id,workflow,status,items_received,items_processed,
       items_skipped,items_failed,duration_seconds,metadata,started_at,finished_at
FROM updated;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::text AS message
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (
    pipeline_run_id,workflow,node,error_type,error_message,retry_count,metadata
  )
  SELECT args.run_id,'06 - TrendLens - Monetization Engine',
         'Calcular Monetization Score','monetization_calculation_error',
         left(regexp_replace(args.message,'(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*','[REDACTED]','g'),4000),
         2,'{}'::jsonb
  FROM args
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=current_timestamp,status='failed',items_failed=items_failed+1,
      duration_seconds=extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at))
  FROM args
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.status,updated.items_failed,
       (SELECT id FROM logged) AS pipeline_error_id
FROM updated;
